traditional: Love, money, and pleasure fused with vitality, authority, and recognition. The two act as one and the combined significations are hard to separate.
modern: Identity blended with charm, pleasure, and a sense of value. Sociability and taste become part of how you show up. Only the conjunction is possible, as Venus stays close to the Sun. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of connection and selfhood is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Tends to be well-liked in the work and to 'look good' doing it.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity fused with egotism and needing to be the center, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.summary: Being chosen can make you want something more than you did before it chose you.
readerCopy.body: Being chosen can make you want something more than you did before it chose you. When the Sun conjuncts Venus, attention, attraction, praise, and pleasure can reinforce your confidence so strongly that another person’s enthusiasm starts influencing your own desire. There is nothing wrong with enjoying the compliment, the invitation, or the feeling of being wanted, but being valued does not automatically make the offer valuable to you. Let the attention land, then notice if you still want what is being offered once you are no longer making the decision from the high of being picked.
